# Import data

```{r}
library(dplyr)
dataset <- read.csv("data/books.csv")
```

# Visualise raw data 
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data = dataset,
       mapping = aes(x = num_pages, y = average_rating)) +
  geom_point()
```
# Clean data
Identify outliers.
```{r}
ggplot(dataset, aes(x = average_rating, y = num_pages)) +
  geom_boxplot() 
```

Remove outliers from the data.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
dataset_v2 <- dataset %>% filter(num_pages < 4000)
```

## Visualise cleaned data
```{r}
# install.packages("ggthemes")
library(ggplot2)
library(ggthemes)
ggplot(dataset_v2, aes(x = num_pages, y = average_rating)) + geom_point() + theme_economist() + labs(
    x = "Number of Pages",
    y = "Average Goodreads Rating",
    title = "Number of Pages vs Average Goodreads Rating")
```
```{r}
ggsave("tb.png")
```
